None is emitted, and grep -rln "analytics|track(" apps/pragma/api/src returns nothing at all, so the application has no event substrate to emit them into. The plan never projected them onto a file either — no row in Files to change mentions them. This is a spec-to-plan gap rather than an implementation defect, so it is not counted as a blocker; the operator decides whether the events ship here or the spec's Analytics section is amended.

U2 — Whether a browser on the public vote page can reach /api/audience in the PREVIEW stage was not verified from here, and the answer differs by stage. In PROD, VITE_API_BASE is unset, so api.client.ts:5-8 resolves the base to '/' and every audience call is same-origin — no preflight, no CORS involved. In PREVIEW, .github/workflows/preview.yml:103 bakes VITE_API_BASE as https://pragma-pr-<n>-api.preview.borso.fr while the site serves from pragma-pr-<n>.preview.borso.fr, so every call is cross-origin against app.ts:32's bare cors(). The new x-ballot-token header makes every vote, retraction and suggestion preflighted; hono 4.12.18 reflects Access-Control-Request-Headers back when allowHeaders is empty, so the header itself should be allowed. But cors() is called with no credentials option, so it answers Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with no Access-Control-Allow-Credentials, while api.client.ts:26 sets credentials: 'include' on every request — a combination browsers refuse. This is pre-existing configuration the diff does not touch and may already be handled by the preview CDN, which is why it is not a blocker. /visual-validation must drive the public page on the preview URL rather than on pnpm dev, or it stays unknown.
